name: Decaying Leaves
flavorText: A mythical giant snake that visits a random populated forest every fall. Enjoys hippie culture.

name: Family of Strange Golems
flavorText: Forgotten ancient machines made by man, burdened with a great power that keeps them alive.

name: Family of Blazing Birds
flavorText: Fiery birds that dream of nothing but attention, often considered a national threat if it migrates above forests.

name: Family of Entertaining Fish
flavorText: Magical fish that try too hard to impress beings more developed than them.
